name: Spencer Gulf Telecasters
summary: Regional SA broadcaster (Spencer Gulf Telecasters, Port Pirie) which also ran a suite of internet products for the Spencer Gulf region under ISP business names 'Central Internet', 'Central Gateway' and 'Central Online' (1998-2001).

events.details: Ran ISP business names Central Internet, Central Gateway, Central Online (1998-2001).

Business names Central Internet and Central Gateway (Spencer Gulf Telecasters Pty Ltd ACN 007 658 782) cancelled 21 Oct 2001; Central Online survived to 02 Dec 2007. TV licences acquired by Southern Cross Broadcasting 01 Apr 2002.

refs.label: Spencer Gulf Telecasters: Central Internet 16 Mar 2000 - 21 Oct 2001
